fixed.summary: A button that is a chosen radio (`role="radio" aria-checked="true"`, such as a quantity among ×1/×10/Max buttons or a segment) wears the default style's selection, as a button with `aria-pressed="true"` does: --button-selected-fill under --button-selected-ink, in every variant, at rest, hovered and held. It was drawn as a plain button, so the chosen one did not show.
